summary: All 5 prior review issues addressed satisfactorily. DinD container leak on GatewayError fixed with dual except handlers covering ContainerSpawnError and catch-all Exception paths. Watchdog timer added with 10-minute default, daemon thread, proper cancellation on teardown, and error-swallowing expiry callback. CI workflows updated with concurrency groups (all three) and path filters (integration tests). Autofix bot no longer watches Integration Tests. integration_test_enabled production wiring documented as intentional Phase 2 deferral with code comments, docs, and an AST-based test. 28 new gap tests pass, 1428 orchestrator tests pass (4 pre-existing failures unchanged). Documentation is accurate and complete.
